comments: Reviewed source composition, source-foot pivots and cell order. Supplemental poses are reviewed proposals, not added animation states.
Exact canvas, stamp and rule timings retained. Native cleanup and plate slicing bake once in the renderer.
geometry: Sweep Danger=(16,TOP−19,216,19); drop=(clamp(player x−24,8,192),TOP−100,48,100). Danger::contains uses x left-inclusive/right-exclusive and y top-exclusive/bottom-inclusive. Bump requires rising knight y in [TOP−60,TOP−22], |x−keeper x|<40 and not Tell.
mapping_basis: Visual review of source sheets and cleanup notes, 2026-10-15

pieces.label: Visual cell 1; Idle: planted profile stance, pulley on back, open hook hanging, swept teal crest and amber slit.
pieces.name: keeper-idle

pieces.label: Visual cell 2; Windup A: braces and hoists the suspended weight overhead.
pieces.name: keeper-drop-tell

pieces.label: Visual cell 3; Attack A: drives the weight down; chain and weight show the drop.
pieces.name: keeper-drop

pieces.label: Visual cell 4; Recovery A: weight is set down as the keeper settles.
pieces.name: keeper-recover

pieces.label: Visual cell 5; Windup B: crouched and draws hook/chain back.
pieces.name: keeper-sweep-tell

pieces.label: Visual cell 6; Attack B: compact close-range hook sweep; refined to remain isolated within its cell.
pieces.name: keeper-sweep

pieces.label: Visual cell 7; Walk/step 1: forward work-step with lifted boot.
pieces.name: keeper-walk-1

pieces.label: Visual cell 8; Walk/step 2: complementary step with weight shifted.
pieces.name: keeper-walk-2

pieces.label: Visual cell 9; Hit flinch: recoils with arms raised and crest thrown back.
pieces.name: keeper-flinch

pieces.label: Visual cell 10; Damage stage 1: one hoop springs outward and faceplate is dented.
pieces.name: keeper-damage-1

pieces.label: Visual cell 11; Damage stage 2: more battered plate/hoop and lowered stance.
pieces.name: keeper-damage-2

pieces.label: Visual cell 12; Defeat: collapsed on the ground with pulley and hook settled alongside.
pieces.name: keeper-defeat

size_basis: 64×80; canvas foot (32,80), top-left (screen keeper x−32,py(TOP)−80). Nested damage_variants in recipe produce two variants per supported acting pose; PNG base-tell files are fallback/loading references, four-stage tells are selected while telling.
timing: Twelve base poses plus four-stage tells per attack; 2 walk frames×7 ticks. Starts Walk=45; tell=33/29/25, action=10, rest=48/40/32 then Walk=30. Recovery pose when rest ticks<12. Flinch=12, player bump cooldown=24; hp stage 6–5/4–3/2–1 (Keeper::step/stage, Lane::step_at, draw()).
